title.zh: SEC Staff Clarifies Token Buybacks and Liquid Staking in New FAQs
title.en: SEC Staff Clarifies Token Buybacks and Liquid Staking in New FAQs

current_state.zh: SEC staff released new FAQs clarifying that qualifying liquid staking receipts fall outside securities laws and reaffirming earlier guidance on token buybacks for maintenance and development funding.
current_state.en: SEC staff released new FAQs clarifying that qualifying liquid staking receipts fall outside securities laws and reaffirming earlier guidance on token buybacks for maintenance and development funding.

updates.background_zh: SEC公司金融部于2025年12月首次发布关于加密资产活动的FAQ，阐述现行证券监管如何适用于数字资产和分布式账本技术。今年3月，该机构又发布解释性文件，说明证券法如何适用于加密资产，包括功能性网络、质押凭证代币以及可能构成投资合同的陈述。此次新FAQ是对上述文件的进一步细化。
updates.background_en: The SEC's Division of Corporation Finance first released FAQs on crypto asset activities in December 2025, outlining how existing securities regulations apply to digital assets and distributed ledger technology. In March, the agency issued an interpretive release on how securities laws apply to crypto assets, including functional networks, staking receipt tokens, and representations that could create an investment contract. The new FAQs expand on those documents.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该澄清直接影响流动性质押服务提供商、其凭证代币以及协议层面的回购计划：非证券的认定会影响这类代币在美国交易平台的上市、托管与获取方式，也影响发行方为网络运营提供资金的途径。由于这是工作人员FAQ而非正式规则，其实际效力取决于监管机构在实践中的适用方式。
updates.market_impact_en: The clarification feeds directly into liquid staking service providers, their receipt tokens and protocol-level buyback programs, since a non-security classification affects how such tokens can be listed, custodied and accessed on U.S. venues and how issuers fund network operations. Because it is staff FAQ rather than a rule, its practical effect depends on how the agency applies it in practice.
